observation.command:
cd /tmp && echo "=== create PDF ===" && (printf '%%!PS /Helvetica findfont 12 scalefont setfont 72 720 moveto (Hello Open Taki PDF validation) show showpage ' > t.ps && ps2pdf t.ps t.pdf 2>/dev/null && echo "ps2pdf ok") || echo "no ps2pdf"; ls -la t.pdf 2>/dev/null; echo "=== PDF extraction ===" && curl -sS -w ' HTTP:%{http_code} ' -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/pdf' --data-binary @t.pdf http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text 2>&1 | head -5; echo "=== DOCX test via pandoc ===" && printf '

DOCX source text for validation.

' > d.html && (pandoc d.html -o d.docx 2>/dev/null && echo "docx created" || echo "no host pandoc"); ls -la d.docx 2>/dev/null && curl -sS -w ' HTTP:%{http_code} ' -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' --data-binary @d.docx http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text 2>&1 | head -5
